official: 立川市災害被災者等援護条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会議案一覧

name: 災害見舞金と援護資金の対象を整理
summary: 条例で、災害見舞金や災害援護資金の貸付などの対象を定めています。改正により、同じ住所に複数の世帯が登録され、実質的に同じ生計を営んでいると市長が認める場合、災害見舞金を受け取れるのは世帯主のうち1人だけになります。災害援護資金の貸付にも同じ扱いを適用します。
changes: 災害見舞金を受け取れる世帯主を1人に限る
災害援護資金の貸付にも同じ制限を適用する
災害弔慰金や災害障害見舞金などの対象要件を示す条文の参照先を改める
貸付けの取消しなどに関する条文の表現を改める
who: 同じ住所に複数の世帯を登録し、実質的に生計を共にする災害被災者
why: 災害見舞金の受給資格者と災害援護資金の貸付対象者の範囲を整理するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Clarifies who can receive disaster victim grants and relief loans
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tachikawa City Ordinance on Assistance for Disaster Victims, etc.
en.summary: The ordinance sets who can receive disaster victim grants and disaster relief fund loans, among other assistance. Under the amendment, if multiple households are registered at the same address and the mayor determines that they effectively share the same livelihood, only one head of household can receive a disaster victim grant. The same rule applies to disaster relief fund loans.
changes: Limits the number of household heads who can receive a disaster victim grant to one
Applies the same restriction to disaster relief fund loans
Changes the cross-reference in the provision setting eligibility requirements for disaster condolence payments, disaster disability grants, etc.
Revises the wording of the provision on cancellation of loans, etc.
who: Disaster victims with multiple households registered at the same address who effectively share a livelihood
Applicants for disaster relief fund loans who meet those same conditions
People covered by the eligibility requirements for disaster condolence payments, disaster disability grants, etc.
Borrowers covered by the provisions on cancellation of loans, etc.
en.why: The city says the changes clarify who is eligible for disaster victim grants and who can receive disaster relief fund loans.
